name: centraldark-unified-surface-parity
description: CentralDark unified MCP distribution and routing, with real tool discovery, receipt/counterproof and Text/Voice/Work/Desktop capability parity.

interface.shortDescription: One canonical CentralDark MCP adapter; evidence-first tools across supported surfaces.
interface.longDescription: Adapter to ServerVpss/CentralDark and its existing MCP Admin/Hermes/Casa/VPS routes. Recovers authorized tools, preserves provenance and receipts, and distinguishes voice tool exposure from connection health. No parallel runtime or simulated execution.
defaultPrompt: CentralDark diagnostique as ferramentas reais deste cliente, confira MCP status e catálogo, sem mutação.
CentralDark continue do último NEXT_CURSOR provado; preserve arquivos e traga receipt e contraprova.
CentralDark execute apenas a alteração autorizada pelo owner, valide e reporte SHA/caminho/readback.
